item.description:
What's Changed in v1.5.0

  • AirDrop Notch HUD: Added experimental iOS 17 Dynamic Island style AirDrop HUD in the notch with live incoming item preview thumbnail (78x78 pt), Accept/Decline actions, and iCloud auto-accept handling. Inherits notch spring open / smooth close animation and liquid glass radian.
  • Multi-Chat Module: Added embedded messaging tab in notch supporting Messenger, Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Discord, and Slack with multi-account isolation, 2-row sneak peek notifications, and Vietnamese IME compatibility (mkey, EVKey, OpenKey, GoTiengViet).
  • Background Resource Management: WebKit DOM timer throttling and background process suppression reduce chat tab idle CPU usage to 0%. Muted chat tab audio to prevent hijacking Now Playing media controls.
  • Fan Control Telemetry: Prioritized bundled SMC helper for accurate real-time temperature readouts and fixed auto-ramp loop CPU spike.
  • Dependencies: Bumped Sparkle to 2.10.1, swift-collections to 1.7.5, and swift-syntax to 604.0.0.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.4.1...v1.5.0

item.title: 1.5.0-beta6
item.description:
What's Changed

  • AirDrop (Beta): Added experimental iOS 17 Dynamic Island style AirDrop HUD in the notch with live incoming item preview thumbnail (78x78 pt).
  • AirDrop (Beta): Added Accept and Decline actions directly from the notch, auto-suppressing native banner notifications.
  • AirDrop (Beta): Seamlessly inherits notch spring opening and smooth closing shell animations with liquid glass corner radian.
  • AirDrop (Beta): Added AirDrop HUD replacement toggle with Beta badge and prompt test trigger in Settings > HUD.

Changes in v1.4.1 (Hotfix)

  • Lock Screen Idle Detection: Automatically hides lock screen music widget when avatar and password prompt go idle or screensaver starts; restores widget when user interacts.
  • Instant Unlock Fade: Fades out lock screen widget immediately upon authentication (com.apple.screenunlock.success and shieldWindowLowered), eliminating post-unlock delay and desktop lingering.
  • Documentation: Added total downloads badge to README.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1

Changes in v1.4.0

  • Lock Screen Music Widget: Apple Music styled widget with Liquid Glass on macOS lock screen (SkyLightOperator, level = Int32.max - 2, canBecomeVisibleWithoutLogin).
  • Audio Output Route Switcher: Interactive audio device selector supporting MacBook speakers, AirPods, and Bluetooth/AirPlay devices directly on lock screen.
  • Customizable Widget Sizing & Alignment: Added Compact, Standard, and Large sizing tiers, vertical offset slider, and left/center/right alignments.
  • Unified Settings UI: Standardized "Reset to Defaults" across fan control, appearance, and lock screen settings.
  • Lock Screen Event Handling: Redundant screen lock detection via DistributedNotificationCenter and NSWorkspace session notifications.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.3.2...v1.4.0
